cd /app/tmp/work && cat > t1.py << 'EOF'
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
c = [0,0,1]
A_eq = [[1,1,0]]; b_eq=[4]
A_ub = [[1,0,-2],[0,1,-2],[0,0,1]]; b_ub=[0,0,1]
res = linprog(c, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=b_ub, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=b_eq, bounds=(0,None), method='highs')
print(res.status, res.fun, res.x)
print('ineqlin', res.ineqlin.marginals)
print('eqlin', res.eqlin.marginals)
y = res.ineqlin.marginals; q = res.eqlin.marginals
A_ub = np.array(A_ub, float); A_eq=np.array(A_eq,float); b_ub=np.array(b_ub,float); b_eq=np.array(b_eq,float)
rc = np.array(c) - (A_ub.T @ y + A_eq.T @ q)
print('reduced costs (should be >= -1e-9):', rc)
L = b_ub @ y + b_eq @ q
print('L', L, 'fun', res.fun)
EOF
python3 t1.py
